QI_GRENADE_CLUSTER.TokenizedDescription: Throw a grenade that deals {Amount1}-{Amount2} damage before splitting into 3 grenades, each dealing {Amount3}-{Amount4} damage. Damage scales with weapon power.
QI_GRENADE_CLUSTER.Description: Throw a grenade that deals 200-375 damage before splitting into 3 grenades, each dealing 96-180 damage. Damage scales with weapon power.

QI_GRENADE_ICE.TokenizedDescription: Throw a grenade that deals {Amount1}-{Amount2} frost damage before splitting into 8 icy orbs that deal {Amount3}-{Amount4} frost damage each. Damage scales with weapon power.
QI_GRENADE_ICE.Description: Throw a grenade that deals 120-225 frost damage before splitting into 8 icy orbs that deal 32-60 frost damage each. Damage scales with weapon power.

QI_GRENADE_INCENDIARY.TokenizedDescription: Throw a grenade that deals {Amount1}-{Amount2} blaze damage and creates a pool of fire that deals {Amount3}-{Amount4} blaze damage over 4 seconds. Damage scales with weapon power.
QI_GRENADE_INCENDIARY.Description: Throw a grenade that deals 120-225 blaze damage and creates a pool of fire that deals 288-540 blaze damage over 4 seconds. Damage scales with weapon power.

QI_GRENADE_HEALING.TokenizedDescription: Throw a grenade that will detonate when impacting a Behemoth, dealing {Amount1}-{Amount2} damage and creating 3 healing orbs that seek out injured Slayers and heal them for {Healing} each. Damage scales with weapon power.
QI_GRENADE_HEALING.Description: Throw a grenade that will detonate when impacting a Behemoth, dealing 240-450 damage and creating 3 healing orbs that seek out injured Slayers and heal them for 120 each. Damage scales with weapon power.

QI_GRENADE_INTERRUPT.TokenizedDescription: Throw a grenade that deals {Amount1}-{Amount2} damage and can interrupt Behemoths. Damage scales with weapon power.
QI_GRENADE_INTERRUPT.Description: Throw a grenade that deals 240-450 damage and can interrupt Behemoths. Damage scales with weapon power.

QI_BOMBING_RUN.TokenizedDescription: Targets an area on the ground for an airstrike, dealing {Amount} damage to all Behemoths inside the area.
QI_BOMBING_RUN.Description: Targets an area on the ground for an airstrike, dealing 2100 damage to all Behemoths inside the area.
